credit-sales-receipt-tip-1: For The Receipt Given To The Customer At The Checkout Counter, Select The Receipt Template With The Corresponding Width According To The Actual Receipt Machine Type
credit-sales-receipt-tip-2: When Selling, Select The Credit Type To Display Or Print Out The Receipt
preliminary-bill-tip: After Receiving The Guest's Payment Request, Proceed To The POS Terminal To Print The Preliminary Bill For The Table And Verify The Charges With The Guest
refund-receipt-tip: For The Refund Receipts Given To Customers At The Checkout Counter, Select Those With The Corresponding Receipt Templates. The Width Is Determined By The Actual Model Of The Cargo Receiving Aircraft
commodity-barcode-label-tip: Select Goods To Print Bar Code Labels For The Goods Themselves Or On Packaging
commodity-price-tag-tip: Select Goods To Print Price Tags For Goods, Labels For Display Shelves And Labels For Weighing Items At Checkout
